name: Wicked Slumber
description: The curse over the land from which nobody can wake.

description_citations.text: "Wilds of Eldraine". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rankle inadvertently completes the trap just as the Phyrexians fall under the Wicked Slumber.
timeline.quote: Rankle inadvertently brought the plan to fruition just as the Phyrexians fell under the Wicked Slumber .

citation.text: "Eldraine", section "Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Talion and the three witch sisters cast the Wicked Slumber on the plane to halt the invasion; it does not lift.
timeline.quote: had cast the Wicked Slumber on the plane to halt the Invasion

citation.text: "Eldraine", section "The Wicked Slumber". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nightmares begin manifesting on Eldraine as a consequence of Ashiok's involvement in the Wicked Slumber, often taking the shape of the Phyrexian invaders.
timeline.quote: Nightmares began manifesting on Eldraine as a consequence of Ashiok's involvement in the Wicked Slumber .

citation.text: "Nightmare", section "Eldraine". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the Invasion the twins unknowingly lose their shared spark as the Wicked Slumber seizes Eldraine.
timeline.quote: the twins unknowingly lost their shared spark

citation.text: "Rowan Kenrith", section "The Wicked Slumber". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Indrelon is stolen and moved to Stormkeld; Will Kenrith abandons Ardenvale for Vantress and has wizards encase Wicked Slumber victims in glass caskets.
timeline.quote: Indrelon was stolen from Castle Vantress and moved to Beluna Grandsquall 's castle, Stormkeld.

citation.text: "Vantress", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eriette, her sisters and Talion are responsible for a curse over Eldraine while others vie for power.
timeline.quote: The witch Eriette , her sisters, and Talion are responsible for a curse that’s lying over the land

citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ashiok arrives on Eldraine to profit from the Wicked Slumber.
timeline.quote: Ashiok has arrived to profit from the Wicked Slumber nobody can wake up from
